chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，就将双方所有宝可梦的令自身'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''的效果的特性全部消除。

english: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Basic Pokémon '''''ex'''''.
chinese: 這隻寶可夢不會受到對手的'''{{TCG|基础宝可梦|基礎}}'''寶可夢的「{{TCG|寶可夢ex|寶可夢'''''ex'''''}}」招式的傷害。

english: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
chinese: 這隻寶可夢受到招式的傷害時，自己擲1次硬幣。若為正面，則這隻寶可夢不會受到那個傷害。

english: If your Wishiwashi or Wishiwashi '''''ex''''' is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if your Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，自己战斗场上的「弱丁鱼（包含『宝可梦'''''ex'''''』）」受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，就给使用了招式的宝可梦身上放置3个伤害指示物。

english: Your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon don't recover from that Special Condition when they evolve or devolve.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，对手处于'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''状态的宝可梦，即使进化、退化也不会恢复'''中毒'''状态。

english: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic {{e|Psychic}} Energy card, a Basic {{e|Metal}} Energy card, or 1 of each and attach them to your {{e|Psychic}} Pokémon and {{e|Metal}} Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合可以使用1次。选择自己牌库中的「基本{{e|超}}能量」和「基本{{e|钢}}能量」各最多1张，以任意方式附着于自己的{{e|超}}或{{e|钢}}宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard the bottom card of your deck. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put this Pokémon on top of your deck.
chinese: 如果这只宝可梦在备战区的话，则在自己的回合可以使用1次。将自己牌库下方1张卡牌放于弃牌区。然后，将放于这只宝可梦身上的卡牌全部放于弃牌区，将这只宝可梦放回牌库上方。

english: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Each player puts a Basic Pokémon from their discard pile onto their Bench. ''(Your opponent puts a Basic Pokémon onto their Bench first.)''
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。双方玩家，各选择自己弃牌区中的1张【基础】宝可梦，放于自己的备战区。（由对手开始放于备战区。）

english: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your hand and you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, you may put this Pokémon onto your Bench.
chinese: 在自己的回合，如果这张卡牌在手牌中，自己的剩余奖赏卡张数，比对手的剩余奖赏卡张数多的话，则可以使用1次。将这张卡牌放于备战区。

english: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your hand and your opponent has any {{TCG|Stage 2 Pokémon}} in play, you may put this Pokémon onto your Bench.
chinese: 在自己的回合，如果这张卡牌在手牌中，对手场上有'''2阶进化'''宝可梦的话，则可使用1次。将这张卡牌放于备战区。

english: If you have Plusle in play, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. The effect of Buddy Pulse doesn't stack.
chinese: 如果自己场上有「{{TCGPM|正电拍拍}}」的话，则能生效。只要这只宝可梦在场上，每当对手从手牌将能量附着于宝可梦身上时，给那只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。这个效果，无论拥有这个特性的宝可梦有多少只，都不会叠加。

english: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, when you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，如果这只宝可梦在备战区的话，则每当从自己的手牌将能量附着于这只宝可梦身上时，可使用1次。将这只宝可梦与战斗宝可梦互换。

english: Whenever your opponent plays a Pokémon from their hand to evolve 1 of their Pokémon, put 4 damage counters on that Pokémon. The effect of Darkest Impulse doesn't stack.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，每当对手从手牌使出宝可梦并进行进化时，就给那只宝可梦身上放置4个伤害指示物。无论拥有这个特性的宝可梦有多少只，这个效果都不会重复。

english: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 90 damage from that Pokémon.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在战斗场上，每当自己从手牌给宝可梦附着能量时，就回复那只宝可梦「90」HP。

english: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，每当对手从手牌将能量附着于宝可梦身上时，给那只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。

english: When 1 of your Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a {{e|雷}} Energy from that Pokémon to this Pokémon.
chinese: 每当自己的宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而'''昏厥'''时，可使用1次。选择'''昏厥'''了的宝可梦身上附着的1张{{e|雷}}能量，转附于这只宝可梦身上。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，选择使用了招式的宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，放于弃牌区。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move up to 2 {{e|Water}} Energy cards from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时，选择这只宝可梦身上附着的最多2张{{e|水}}能量，转附于自己的1只备战宝可梦身上。

english: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时，选择自己牌库中任意1张卡牌，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而'''昏厥'''时，在不看正面的前提下，选择对手的2张手牌，放于弃牌区。

english: When 1 of your {{e|Water}} Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may put all Basic {{e|Water}} Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand instead of the discard pile.
chinese: 每当自己的{{e|水}}宝可梦受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时，可以使用1次。不将'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''了的宝可梦身上附着的「基本{{e|水}}能量」放于弃牌区，而是全部放回手牌。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon that have "Koffing" in their name and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，选择自己牌库中最多2张名字中带有「瓦斯弹」的宝可梦，放于备战区。并重洗牌库。

english: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon has no Abilities, except for Midnight Fluttering.
chinese: 只要這隻寶可夢在戰鬥場上，對手的戰鬥寶可夢的特性（「暗夜羽擊」除外）全部消除。

english: Put this Pokémon into play only with the effect of Palafin's Zero to Hero Ability.
chinese: 这张卡牌，只有通过「海豚侠」的特性「全能变身」的效果才能被放于场上。

english: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from the Active Spot to the Bench, you may search your deck for a {{DL|Palafin (TCG)|Palafin ex}} and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当这只宝可梦从战斗场被放回备战区时，可使用1次。选择自己牌库中的1张「海豚侠{{ex}}」，与这张卡牌互换（继承放于其身上的所有卡牌、伤害指示物、特殊状态、效果等）。如果互换了的话，则将这张卡牌放回牌库。并重洗牌库。

english: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, their new Active Pokémon is now Burned.
chinese: 只要這隻寶可夢在場上，在對手的回合，每次對手的戰鬥寶可夢回到備戰區時，將新上場的寶可夢'''灼傷'''。

english: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. ''(You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)''
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，自己所有已经进化的宝可梦，可以使用其所有进化前拥有的招式。''[需要满足使用招式所需能量。]''

english: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any of your Benched Pokémon. ''<nowiki>(You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)</nowiki>''
chinese: 这只宝可梦可以使用自己备战宝可梦所拥有的全部招式。''<nowiki>[需要满足使用招式所需能量。]</nowiki>''

english: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
chinese: 如果场上有「祭典会场」的话，则这只宝可梦，可以连续使用2次拥有的招式。（如果第1次的招式令对手的战斗宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''的话，则在下一只对手的宝可梦被放于战斗场后，继续使用第2次招式。）

english: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
chinese: 如果场上有「{{TCG|祭典会场}}」的话，则这只宝可梦，可以连续使用2次拥有的招式。（如果第1次的招式令对手的战斗宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''的话，则在下一只对手的宝可梦被放于战斗场后，继续使用第2次招式。）

english: If {{TCG|Festival Grounds}} is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.
chinese: 如果场上有「{{TCG|祭典会场}}」的话，则这只宝可梦，可以连续使用2次拥有的招式。（如果第1次的招式令对手的战斗宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''的话，则在下一只对手的宝可梦被放于战斗场后，继续使用第2次招式。）

english: If you took this Pokémon as a face-down Prize card during your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench. If you put this Pokémon onto your Bench in this way, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当从反面朝上的自己的奖赏卡中拿取了这张卡牌时，如果自己的备战区有空位的话，则在加入手牌前可以使用。将这只宝可梦放于自己的备战区。然后，抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则额外拿取1张奖赏卡。

english: Whenever your opponent plays an {{TCG|Item card|Item}} or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.
chinese: 这只宝可梦，当对手从手牌使出物品或者支援者时，不受其效果影响。

english: If you have Solrock in play, prevent all effects of any Stadium done to your Pokémon in play.
chinese: 如果自己场上有「{{TCGPM|太阳岩}}」的话则能生效。只要这只宝可梦在场上，自己所有的宝可梦，不会受到竞技场的效果影响。

english: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.
chinese: 当对手从手牌使出物品或支援者时，这只宝可梦不会受到其效果影响。

english: Your opponent's Pokémon in play and all attached cards can't be put into your opponent's hand.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，对手场上的宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，都无法被放回手牌。

english: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to all of your Pokémon.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在战斗场上，自己所有的宝可梦，当对手从手牌使出支援者时，不受其效果影响。

english: Cards in your opponent's discard pile can't be put into their hand by an effect of your opponent's Abilities or Trainer cards.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，对手弃牌区中的卡牌，就无法因为对手的特性或训练家的效果，被加入对手的手牌。
